proofs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM tasks AS child JOIN tasks AS parent ON parent.id = child.parent_task_id WHERE child.parent_task_id IS NOT NULL AND (parent.workspace_id <> child.workspace_id OR parent.parent_task_id IS NOT NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT source_note_id FROM tasks WHERE source_note_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source_note_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM workspaces WHERE planning_period_id IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM workspaces AS workspace LEFT JOIN planning_periods AS period ON period.id = workspace.planning_period_id WHERE workspace.planning_period_id IS NOT NULL AND period.id IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM planning_periods WHERE (start_date IS NOT NULL AND start_date NOT GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]') OR (end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date NOT GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]') OR (start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND start_date > end_date)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM workspace_sponsorships AS sponsorship JOIN workspace_members AS membership ON membership.workspace_id = sponsorship.workspace_id AND membership.user_id = sponsorship.sponsor_id WHERE sponsorship.status = 'active'
